title: Initial verification evidence review: 25-model cohort
scope: Initial primary-source review of 25 models across payload, energy runtime, task autonomy and industrial maturity, with additional version and customer/document cross-checks for selected models. No physical testing, performance replication or complete operational audit was performed.
selection_method: Editorial cohort spanning North America, Europe and Asia; industrial products, household platforms and research robots; bipedal and wheeled configurations; mixed commercial and research visibility. This is not an objective world top-25 ranking or a representative statistical sample.
limitations: A source review is not an independent audit.
Not established means absent or unresolved in the inspected sources, not absent everywhere.
A product-page claim remains V1 even when the page calls a section Technical Specifications.
Existing catalogue values are preserved; this overlay does not silently replace the data source.
HRL assessments cover only their named source-backed activity. No HRL4+, rated-load duty cycle or independent physical audit is claimed.

sources.locator: Hardware: Robot and Battery; Utility: Expert Mode

payload.finding: OEM distinguishes 55 lb carry, 154 lb lift and 18 lb arm load. Duration, reach and bilateral thermal protocol are not established.

runtime.finding: Four-hour runtime claim has no rated-load cycle; quick-charge claim lacks a state-of-charge window.

autonomy.finding: Foundational autonomy, scheduled remote Expert Mode and VR/mobile control coexist. Intervention frequency and L0-L3 level are not established.

hrl.finding: Reservations do not establish a paid industrial pilot or scaled operation.

records.next_action: Obtain version-specific test conditions and first-hand operational evidence; preserve the source before any upgrade.
